title: Spore Drift
author: CMDR Snickerdoodlez
description: A dark, organic sound pack made for the Fungoida theme: wet bubbles, woody knocks, spore puffs, low drones and glassy bells in D minor, with a creak or two from the mycelium. Every one of the app's 29 sounds, from hovering over a button to a jump and a promotion. Works with any theme.
